function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an SMS or WhatsApp notification to the customer containing their secure payment link for the overdue EMI.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer. Use 'CUST_9988' for Rahul Sharma.

amount.description: The amount to be collected. Default is 8499.00.

channel.description: The communication channel to send the payment link.
